note: Heading H1-H6 and Custom Heading share the same properties. Custom Heading adds a Start Slot and an End Slot.

properties.name: visualSize
properties.default: per level: H1=h1, H2=h2, H3=h3, H4=h4, H5=h5, H6=h6

design.name: 🔀 Visual Size
design.note: Each heading level has its own default value for Visual Size. The levels h1-h6 map to the headline font sizes, p-small, p-medium and p-large to the body font sizes sm, md and lg.

design.name: 🔀 Font Weight
design.note: Regular is intended for the paragraph sizes p-small, p-medium and p-large.

design.name: 📦 Start
design.note: Only on Custom Heading. Slot for content before the heading text, for example an icon.

design.name: 📦 End
design.note: Only on Custom Heading. Slot for content after the heading text, for example links or badges.
